biography: Andy Gulliford, a name synonymous with audacious overtakes and a 'never say die' attitude in the Superkart 250cc scene, hails from a small village in Oxfordshire. His racing journey began not on asphalt, but on muddy fields, tearing around on a beat-up quad bike gifted by his grandfather. This early exposure ignited a passion that quickly outgrew rural pursuits. By 16, he was competing in local karting championships, his raw talent evident, albeit tempered by a tendency for flamboyant, sometimes reckless, maneuvers. A defining moment came at the 2018 Superkart National Championships, where, despite starting last after a mechanical failure, he clawed his way to second place, showcasing his remarkable overtaking ability. Now, at 28, and considered to be in his prime, Gulliford is a seasoned competitor, balancing his innate aggression with a newfound strategic maturity, chasing that elusive championship title.
drivingStyle: Gulliford's driving style is best described as aggressive and opportunistic. He's known for late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of both his kart and the track. While he has matured in recent years, learning to conserve tires and manage race pace when necessary, his default setting is still full-throttle. He excels in wet conditions, where his car control and willingness to take risks give him a distinct advantage. Some argue that his aggressive nature can lead to mistakes, but Gulliford believes that 'fortune favors the bold,' and he isn't afraid to push the boundaries to gain an edge.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. If you're not willing to risk it all, you might as well stay home."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2019 British Superkart Grand Prix in dominant fashion, leading from pole position and setting the fastest lap, proving his ability to perform under immense pressure.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 World Championships, costing him a potential world title and resulting in a lengthy period of self-doubt.
